fact: The brief is published by REPOA with the University of Dodoma, Tanzanian institutions, and reviews data protection for platform workers in Tanzania.

Doreen F. Mwamlangala of the Open University of Tanzania published a doctrinal study in the African Journal of Law and Practice on higher learning institutions' compliance with Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Act, finding compliance extremely low.

Tech & Media Convergency (TMC), with the Internet Governance Tanzania Working Group of 25 organisations, published the April 2025 report 'The State of Internet Governance and Analysis on Emerging Digital Threats in Tanzania' covering 2024, part of its Tanzania State of Internet Governance Series.
